data.name: Hekker
data.long_meaning: Derived from the ancient Greek word 'hekate', Hekker means 'warrior protector' in English. In Greek mythology, Hecate was the goddess of magic, witchcraft, and protection, especially for women and children. The name Hekker embodies strength, courage, and a guardian spirit.
